theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lip_vitali_two_measure_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (r : Euclid P → ℝ) (R₀ : ℝ) (c : ℝ≥0∞), (∀ y ∈ A, 0 < r y ∧ r y ≤ R₀ ∧ closedBall y (r y) ⊆ B ∧ μ (A ∩ closedBall y (5 * r y)) ≤ c * ν (closedBall y (r y))) → μ A ≤ c * ν B
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
